moburst.notes: Moburst = real mobile/digital marketing agency (US/IL). Job-task scam site lt-moburstmobile.pages.dev uses its name. Same entity_id for any "Moburst" casing variant.

Koka Kona.notes: No company or product called "Koka Kona" found (web search 2026-11-26); fake investment app akk500.com. Name may be a play on Coca-Cola, but SPF treats it as the scam brand itself.

Red Bull.notes: Name/logo misused on fake investment site angel-investment.cc. www.redbull.com blocks curl (403 Akamai); official domain from established knowledge.

SimplyGo.notes: SimplyGo (public-transport fare system, LTA/TransitLink). Phishing page on compromised .be site.

SingHealth.notes: Singapore Health Services cluster; scam polyclinic-a.top imitates SingHealth Polyclinics (polyclinic.singhealth.com.sg host from established knowledge).

Dance Prize.notes: Fake "Dance Prize" voting/competition used for credential phishing (votegrand.sbs); SPF says it is used to impersonate legitimate organisations generally, no specific real entity.

Genwrk Store.notes: Fake job-task "store" (genwrk.com); no real company of that name found (web search 2026-11-26).

uParcel.notes: SG same-day courier/3PL. Parcel phishing on llvtx.cfd.

SG Arrival Card (SGAC).notes: ICA SG Arrival Card (free e-service at eservices.ica.gov.sg/sgarrivalcard -> /arrivalcard). Fee-charging lookalike digitalarrivalform.com.

UOB Kay Hian.notes: SG stockbroker. uobkayhian.com -> uobkh.com and utrade.com.sg -> uobkh.com.sg (redirects observed 2026-11-26). Lookalike uobkhs.com.

Youlemei Mall.notes: Fake e-commerce "mall" for task/boosting job scams (youlemeimall.vip); no real company found (web search 2026-11-26).

SP Group.notes: SG power/utilities provider; billing phishing via samgirasg.com.

PETROBRAS.notes: Brazilian state oil company; name misused for fake oil investment app (peshiyou.top).

ADGM MONEY.notes: Fake investment platform name built on ADGM (Abu Dhabi Global Market, a real financial centre/regulator). No genuine ADGM product called "ADGM MONEY"; SPF says scammers use "names similar to ADGM MONEY" to impersonate financial entities. Real-entity clone; human may prefer fictitious_scam_brand.

Best Hotel Reservation.notes: Tag not mentioned in advisory body; SPF text speaks generically of "hotel reservation services" phishing (gardes-holdenjp.com). Probably the fake page's display name; does not identify a real organisation.

GitHub.notes: GitHub name misused on fake investment site goudann.top.

QNT.notes: QNT = token of Quant Network (UK). Fake "QNT AI" investment site qntai.top. quant.network returned a Cloudflare challenge to curl; domain from established knowledge.

Miniex.notes: "MiniEx" self-describes (only on a zendesk help-centre) as a Chicago-founded licensed exchange with no independent confirmation; SPF names it as the scam brand with miniexi.com. Treated as the fraudulent platform itself.

GOM Player.notes: GOM Player = media player by GOM & Company (KR). SPF: investment scam sites "misuse the names of well-known, unrelated brands". Same media-player-name pattern as MPC-HC and Televizo tags.

Immediate Edge.notes: Well-known fake auto-trading "robot" brand (part of the Immediate Edge/Connect/etc. family promoted via fake celebrity ads); SPF calls it a "legitimate-sounding platform". Not a real firm.

BHP.notes: Australian mining major; name misused for fake gold investment (2025gold.net). bhp.com blocks curl (403); domain from established knowledge.

lyft bikes.notes: Lyft bikeshare (lyft.com/bikes). Fake "invest in shared bikes" platform lyft098236.work.

The Straits Times.notes: SPH Media newspaper; fake ST-branded articles/ads push investment scams (strikeathletics.pro).

Public Transport Voucher (PTVE).notes: MOT Public Transport Voucher Exercise; genuine application link is go.gov.sg/ptv (per MOT news release found via search). Fake claim site gtva.link.

Home Team Science & Technology Agency (H.notes: HTX statutory board under MHA; phishing qer012.online.

DBS PayLah.notes: PayLah! = DBS/POSB mobile wallet; same entity_id as "DBS". Scam posb.live.

XCN.notes: XCN = Onyxcoin token of Onyx Protocol (onyx.org). SPF body only names the site xcnc.top, so the tag most likely refers to this token name being misused; low confidence.
